subject: Redwood discovery — recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood discovery — recap & next steps

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:

- Pain / priority: Reduce per-token inference cost for customer-facing chat, improve 99th percentile latency under load, and get audit logs for compliance.
- Current footprint: 4 services using a mix of LLMs; most traffic is peak-hour interactive chat (50k/day).
- What we showed: Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput, prefix/KV caching to reduce redundant tokens, and rollout policies for safe canary.

Proposed next steps:
1) Share a one-page mutual action plan (attached) + first-pass SOW draft for dedicated capacity (Aditya will own pricing).
2) Technical deep-dive with your infra/ML infra team — Dev to lead and validate network/KMS requirements.
3) Target timeline: pilot in staging within 6–8 weeks if security sign-off is OK.

Can you confirm who from your side should be on the tech call? I put Aditya and Dev on the thread; we’re available Tue/Wed next week between 10–2 PT.

Attachment: ACME-Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 124KB)
Attachment: SOW-draft-REDWOOD-ACME.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 48KB)

Thanks — excited to keep the momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
